title: VOOL Charger – 22 kW smart EV charger with a 5-year warranty
description: Up to 22 kW, 6.5 m Type 2 cable, IP55 and IK10, works from −30 °C to +45 °C. Modular installation on a wall or pole.

sections.title: Reliable charging, built for northern weather
sections.lead: Up to 22 kW for any electric car, at home, at work or in a shared car park. Backed by a 5-year warranty.

items.title: Works with every EV
items.text: A fixed 6.5 m cable with a Type 2 plug. Nothing to carry, nothing to forget.

items.title: Lower charging costs
items.text: With the VOOL App the car charges when electricity is cheapest. Users save up to 30%.

items.title: Quick to install
items.text: Mount the casing on a wall or a VOOL pole, click in the controller, attach the front panel.

sections.alt: VOOL Charger in black, aluminium and wood
sections.title: Three finishes, one clean design
sections.text: Choose the front panel that suits the building: black, aluminium or wood. The charger looks at home on a house wall and in a company car park.

sections.alt: VOOL Charger opened: casing, orange charge controller and front panel
sections.title: Prepare every parking space now, finish later
sections.text: The casing and the charging controller are separate. Install casings for all spaces during building work and add controllers as drivers switch to electric.
points: Chargers talk to each other and share the available power

items.title: Ready for the AFIR rule that starts on 1 January 2027
items.text: The new VOOL Charger supports ISO 15118-2, ISO 15118-20 and Plug & Charge. V2G follows by firmware update in Q1 2027. Existing chargers can be upgraded by swapping the controller.

cells: IP55 weather resistance, IK10 impact protection
ISO 15118-2 and -20, Plug & Charge (chargers produced from December 2026)
Dynamic phase switching with VOOL LMC
Wall or VOOL pole; modular casing and controller

items.title: MID wall charger
items.text: With a certified meter for billing by the kWh. Coming in 2027.

items.title: Commercial Pole
items.text: Two 22 kW charging points with display and QR payment for public sites.

items.title: Accessories
items.text: Poles, cable holder, front panels and spare parts.

sections.title: Get a VOOL Charger
sections.lead: Our partners sell and install VOOL across Europe.
